{{Top|leg}}
The '''Baobab Larynx-7''' was a model of reed whistle that allowed a being to communicate with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]]. It emulated whistles, chirps, and buzzes which the droid could understand, assuming it did not already understand the language of said user.

The Larynx-7 was a popular model, however could easily be misused in the wrong hands. Once upon a transgalactic starliner, some [[Howler Tree People|Howler Tree children]] got hold of a Larynx-7 and commanded the entire droid service crew to engage in a cabinwide food fight. This forced the pilot to terminate the flight in the [[Gulf of Tatooine/Legends|Gulf of Tatooine]] so as to clean the cockpit window. Thus the instrument was only to be used by adults.
